name: ksolovev/fine-news
description:
FineNews
	

FineNews is a multilingual news-text dataset for language-model research. It filters and deduplicates a 2021–2025 snapshot of the INFINI-NEWS Corpus, which extracts articles from Common Crawl CC-News.

	
		
	
	
		At a glance
	


	
		
Measure
FineNews


		
Input articles
852,824,802 Infini-News rows from 2021–2025


Output
392,627,654 physical rows


Files
294,509 Parquet files


Folders
60 publication months (2021-01 to 2025-12), then language


Language folders
129… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ksolovev/fine-news.
